correctness.rationale: Independence and the one-sided reflection principle give S_i and the killed kernel at variance 2D_i t. The cycle mean is μ, finite and positive for N>2 by the t^(−N/2) survival product. Finite-mean nonlattice regeneration at the common zero gives the stationary normalized cycle occupation measure. Integrating each tagged killed kernel to −Rc_j gives the Gaussian integral over [Rc_j,Rc_j+2L_j]; an untagged kernel instead integrates over [−L_i,L_i]. Independently of the frozen dominated-convergence argument, let U_i be independent uniforms over these respective intervals. Tonelli permits integrating t first, giving the exact joint probability A Γ(ν)4^ν/μ times E[(∑ U_i²/D_i)^(−ν)]. Since J is nonempty and the tagged depths are fixed positive, the scaled quadratic form converges uniformly over the windows to ∑ c_j²/D_j and stays bounded away from zero. This yields the claimed limit and positive prefactor for every J, including all coordinates. Dividing the pair constant by the one-coordinate constant gives (D_j/(D_i+D_j))^ν. The bounded positive side and tail integration give exactly p<N−2 and logarithmic divergence of the boundary truncated moment. Independent compact-box quadrature reproduced μ≈0.35698468349 and limiting constants 1.16798046352 and 0.38932682117, and tested a pair at unequal depths.
residual_risks: Quadrature is a spot check, not an asymptotic proof. The tail comparison is at common physical depth, so it can be asymmetric. The conventional equal-marginal-quantile lower-tail coefficient instead equals 2^(−ν); the frozen formula is explicitly for equal depths. Parameters and relative depths are fixed and no uniformity is asserted.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct contribution is the sharp joint coefficient across all nonempty tagged subsets of an arbitrarily heterogeneous system, including its common-depth conditional consequence. The exact homogeneous stationary mixture, N>2 cutoff, and homogeneous case of the tail theorem are covered. The strongest exact overlapping catalogue statement has common D and L, plus a conditional age law; it cannot normalize away arbitrary ratios L_i/√D_i. The external-interval stationary mixture does not give the killed conditional kernels of this state-triggered reset model. No inspected statement establishes the fully heterogeneous joint asymptotic or its parameter dependence.
residual_risks: Broader regular-variation or regenerative-mixture work may implicitly supply this specialization. The search is bounded, and no catalogue-date ordering is used as proof of priority.

value.rationale: A single finite population has a genuinely shared heavy-tailed renewal age. The exact directional coefficients quantify which large excursions still co-occur at a common physical depth, and distinguish dependence on diffusivities from the thresholds that affect the absolute rates. The moment cutoff also gives concrete integrability information in a stationary regime. These are natural observables of the model; the heterogeneous family is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
residual_risks: No large-N scaling, equal-quantile asymmetry, or change-of-trigger claim follows. The dependence proof uses known regenerative machinery.
